title: I asked AI to build a low-poly lighthouse - progress photos
author: spacespacespapce
selftext:
The prompt I used: "cute low poly lighthouse"

Took 4 mins and 8 iterations in Blender.

replies.author: Denaton_
replies.body: Have had a build pending for 14h, something seems broken on that site..

comments.author: aCaffeinatedMind
comments.body: So you wasted about 4 months supply of water for a family living in poverty instead of spending like 10 mintues watching a blender video and do it yourself?

replies.author: Toastti
replies.body: A local LLM running on gaming computer can do this. It uses no more power than playing a intensive game like cyberpunk for 10 minutes.

replies.author: aCaffeinatedMind
replies.body:
Still I question why you wouldn't just spend 10 minutes and teach yourself to do It. 


This is literally 101 in modeling.

replies.author: odragora
replies.body: You should instead question yourself why you are desperately searching for any excuse to hate on a new tool and lecture people you don't know on how they should utilize their own time. Wasting it on acquiring a skill they don't need instead of creating a new product they are actually excited about.

replies.author: Venom4992
replies.body:
That's not true, really. Just learning how to navigate blender takes longer than that, then even if you created the model in 10 mins, you would still need to learn textures and uv unwrapping.

Even though I am pretty good with Blender, I still decided out of pure interest to ask ChatGPT to make a guide for creating a light shaft in Unity, including the textures, and I was actually quite impressed.

How much water did I use?
